summary: A button that shows one chosen option and opens a list to choose another.

value.description: The value of the chosen option.

name.description: The name the value is submitted under.

placeholder.description: The text shown while no option is chosen.

open.description: The list is showing. A script adds and removes it.

required.description: The form cannot be submitted while nothing is chosen.

disabled.description: It cannot be opened or focused.

root.note: The control: it takes focus, shows the chosen option's text and a chevron at the end, and is the anchor the popup is placed against. It is a tooltip's width unless the author sizes it, so that defining it, which creates the value part, does not move it.

value.note: The text of the chosen option, or the placeholder, marked data-placeholder and painted in the muted ink. A value too long for the select ends in an ellipsis.

popup.note: The element marked data-part="popup" that holds the listbox. It shows in the top layer while open.

keys.ArrowDown: Opens the list on the chosen option; in an open list, moves to the next option.
keys.ArrowUp: Opens the list; in an open list, moves to the previous option.
keys.Home: Opens the list on the first option, or moves to it.
keys.End: Opens the list on the last option, or moves to it.
keys.Enter: Opens the list; in an open list, chooses the option and closes.
keys.Space: Opens the list; in an open list, chooses the option and closes.
keys.Escape: Closes the list and keeps the value.
keys.Tab: In an open list, chooses the option, closes, and moves on.
keys.a character: Moves to the next option that starts with what was typed, opening the list.

events.input: Dispatched when the user chooses another option.

guidance.text: The author names the select with aria-label or aria-labelledby, or puts it in a form field.

Write `value` on the select and `selected` on the chosen option, so that both are painted before the select is defined. The select is a tooltip's width unless the author gives it an inline-size: its width cannot follow its text, which only exists once it is defined.
The list is a listbox with options inside the popup part. Focus stays on the select; the option the keys point at is named by aria-activedescendant.

notYet: A width that follows the widest option.
